name: audit-state-machines
description: Find every implicit and explicit state machine in a codebase, model each one formally, and report every bug the model shows and the code confirms — a bad state that can be reached, a forbidden transition, a state with no way out — with its fix and an offer to turn the findings into Tickets. Changes no code. Use when the user asks to audit state machines, find implicit state machines, check status or lifecycle logic across an app, or find status or lifecycle bugs that span several files.
